integrity: The Reynolds identity is reconstructed directly from the determinant bracket and reduced to one vector equation. The finite-field count is derived by disjoint structural cases and rational-canonical counting. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies every matrix over F2 and F3 and replays the closed formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the fixed three-dimensional 3-Lie algebra with [e1,e2,e3]=e1.
The finite-field count uses the standard similarity classification for matrices with characteristic polynomial X^2(X-t).
title: Reynolds moduli of the three-dimensional \(3\)-Lie algebra
